parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Aluminium oxide is used to make calcium aluminate. Calcium aluminate contains calcium ions, Ca 2+ , and aluminate ions, Al O 2 – . Write the formula of calcium aluminate. ..................................................................................................................................... [1]

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) When aluminium oxide reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid, aqueous aluminium chloride and one other product are formed. Write the symbol equation for the reaction between aluminium oxide and dilute hydrochloric acid. ..................................................................................................................................... [2]

ms.label: 6(a)(iii)
ms.text:
6HCl + Al2O3 → 2AlCl3 + 3H2O
M1 AlCl3 as product
M2 correct equation

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) When aqueous silver nitrate is added to aqueous aluminium chloride, a precipitate of silver chloride, AgCl, is produced. Write an ionic equation for this precipitation reaction. Include state symbols. ..................................................................................................................................... [2]
